title: The Greenhouse Door
description: A retired botanist decides to finally cultivate the rare alpine seeds she kept in her freezer for decades.
character_reference: an elderly woman with silver hair pulled into a loose braid, wearing a heavy cable-knit cardigan and mud-smudged gardening gloves

scenes.narration: For thirty years, the little foil packets sat tucked safely behind bags of frozen peas, forgotten by everyone but me.
scenes.visual: Opening a frosty freezer drawer and pulling out a small, crinkled paper seed packet covered in handwritten botanical notes

scenes.narration: They were seeds of the blue Himalayan poppy, notoriously difficult to grow, requiring frost and absolute patience.
scenes.visual: Emptying tiny brown seeds onto a rough wooden palm, examining them closely under natural daylight spilling through a window

scenes.narration: My career had been spent teaching others how to preserve plants, while my own ambitions withered in the shade.
scenes.visual: Looking out through a misted glass window at an overgrown backyard garden in autumn, holding a trowel loosely at her side

scenes.narration: I cleared away the dead winter vines inside the glass frame and filled terracotta pots with fresh soil.
scenes.visual: Pressing dark soil firmly into a clay flowerpot with calloused fingers, dust particles floating in a sunbeam

scenes.narration: There is a strange comfort in getting your hands dirty again after so many years of safe observation.
scenes.visual: Wiping a smudge of damp earth across a cheek with the back of a gloved hand, looking down at the planted pots with satisfaction

scenes.narration: Nature does not rush its greatest displays, and neither should we when our own season arrives.
scenes.visual: Placing a glass dome gently over a seedling tray inside a bright greenhouse, condensation beading on the clear surface

scenes.narration: I set the final tray on the wooden bench and waited for the first stubborn sign of life.
scenes.visual: Leaning down to inspect a row of small pots aligned on a wooden slat bench, warm sunlight washing over the scene

scenes.narration: Follow along for more gentle reminders that it is never too late to plant what you love.
scenes.visual: Standing proudly inside a sunlit glasshouse filled with green foliage, smiling gently at the viewer
